title: Manual and Auto Scan app/process restart safety

scope.claim: B08/D04 restart safety is closed at current offline/browser scope through explicit safe rejection and truthful Auto server restoration; no intentional live-game mid-scan process kill is claimed.

manualScanRestart.failureFirst: A durable scan_runs row can survive abrupt app/process loss in status=running even though a new ManualMapScanCommandService starts idle and public resumeAvailable is always false.
manualScanRestart.policy: Each profile map-data database has an exclusive scan-owner lease. Only the exclusive lease owner may reconcile persisted running rows. After prior-owner loss, running rows become failed with the explicit restart interruption reason before any fresh scan can begin.
manualScanRestart.interruptedError: map scan interrupted by application restart

deterministicProof.simulatedAbruptLoss: Begin one scan, persist one successful block checkpoint and staged row, then dispose the database without Stop/Fail/Publish.

startRejected.message: A map scan is already in progress.

autoScanRestart.failureFirst: The scheduler persisted nextRunAt but no durable in-flight cycle identity. An app/process loss before the cycle finally block could leave nextRunAt still due and allow reopening to re-admit the interrupted target list.
autoScanRestart.policy: Persist a per-profile Auto cycle marker before target travel. On a later app instance, process the marker before ordinary due-cycle admission. Never resume the interrupted target list. If return-to-origin was enabled, restore the original authoritative server first; only after successful restoration advance nextRunAt and clear the marker. Failed restoration retains the marker for retry.

visualComparison.note: The initial full-suite Hotkeys dark zh-CN capture had MAE 3.4106877310740937e-06 with zero high-delta pixels; isolated recapture returned exact equality, restoring 28/28 strict identity.

releaseBuild.hashDifferenceReason: The staged index-only snapshot has no .git metadata, so the .NET SDK does not embed SourceRevisionId in AssemblyInformationalVersion; application source is identical.

B08.rationale: The acceptance requirement allows compatible resume OR explicit safe rejection. Public resume remains unsupported; R7-136 durably fails orphaned running rows, preserves partial checkpoints and last trustworthy published data, rejects stale publication, and prevents concurrent ownership.

D04.rationale: Disable/Stop/reconnect were already covered. R7-136 adds app/process restart semantics: interrupted Auto target lists are never resumed, return-to-origin is restored before future scheduling when required, failed restoration retries without scan admission, and return-disabled cycles preserve current server.

remainingStrongerEvidence: No intentional live-game OS process kill was performed during an active scan; R7-136 is offline/file-backed/browser restart acceptance, not LIVE-PROVEN restart.
D02 still requires at least three authorized full multi-server Auto cycles as one acceptance set.
Final normal-user built-executable walkthrough remains open.
Ghost/Supplies and state-changing action gates remain separately population/authorization dependent.
